newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Eagle upgrades Nimary gold resource.
newsitem.headline: Eagle upgrades Nimary gold resource.

text.p: Gold miner Eagle Mining Ltd on Monday upgraded the resource at its Nimary gold mine to 1.134 million ounces, up 169,500 ounces from March before mine depletion.
Eagle said in its quarterly report that Nimary produced 30,004 ounces of gold in the June quarter, for annual production of 117,237 ounces.
First quarter production last year was 31,376 ounces.
Eagle said net cash costs for quarter were A$238 per ounce, for an average year to date net cash cost of A$222 per ounce.

The Western Australia producer also said it planned a A$6 million plant upgrade at Nimary to boost annual throughput to 1.25 million tonnes of ore from 825,000, to produce an average 150,000 ounces of gold a year.
